prompt: Your friend is walking out the door angry mid-conversation. Write what you'd say in the next ten seconds to make them stay.
response: Wait! Don't go! Please stop! I'm sorry I didn't mean it! Just listen to me! We can fix this! Don't leave me here alone! Come back! I love you! Don't go!
